ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_contrastive_advantage_weighted_sum
ir.intuition: Use a pairwise contrastive loss based on advantage gap, weighting softplus of negative scaled log-probability differences by normalized weights, aggregating by a weighted sum instead of mean to emphasize higher weighted pairs more strongly.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
l_diff = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']
score = l_diff / (abs(adv_gap) + epsilon)
loss_per_pair = softplus(-score)
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss) / sum(weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    abs_adv = ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), epsilon)
    l_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    score = ops.div(l_diff, abs_adv)
    neg_score = ops.neg(score)
    loss_vec = ops.softplus(neg_score)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_vec, weight)
    total_weight = ops.sum(weight)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), total_weight)
    return loss
